notes:
Pen haptic settings now match across a paired set.

**The pen's buzz settings now travel from the main tablet to the second one.** If you have two tablets paired and set the strength or feel on the main one, the second tablet quietly kept its own and you had to match them by hand. It now follows along, the same way the page-turn zone and the stylus-hover setting already did.

Set these on the MAIN tablet. The second tablet takes its settings from it, so a change made on the second tablet will be replaced the next time the main one sends its own.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
